**{anndataR}** is an R implementation of the [`AnnData`](https://anndata.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html) data structure, used in the Python scverse ecosystem.
It provides an R `AnnData` object with native reading and writing of H5AD files.
Users can interact with the `AnnData` object directly, or use flexible functions to convert to and from  [`SingleCellExperiment`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SingleCellExperiment/) or [`Seurat`](https://satijalab.org/seurat/) objects.
